user.title: Fenton Home Feedback
user.description: Paste a fine-grained GitHub token with access to only the request repository and Issues set to Read and write. The Fenton Home app files bug reports and feature requests through Home Assistant with it, so the app never holds a GitHub token.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the GitHub token
reauth_confirm.description: GitHub no longer accepts the token for {repository}. Paste a new fine-grained token with Issues set to Read and write.

error.no_repository_access: The token can't reach that repository. Give it access to the request repository.
error.rate_limited: GitHub is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.repository_public: That repository is public. Reports include screenshots of the house, so choose the private request repository (SFenton/fenton-hass-requests).

abort.already_configured: This repository is already set up.
